svg.title: IBM Planning Analytics and Cognos Analytics in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: Three of IBM's figures: seven kinds of plan IBM lists for Planning Analytics; a 30-day free trial of Cognos Analytics on Cloud On-Demand, including 5 Premium users; Planning Analytics Standard counted per 16 gigabytes. Each figure is IBM's. The 30-day length is IBM's for Cognos Analytics on Cloud On-Demand only; IBM offers trials of the other products without stating their length. IBM states no test conditions for these figures.
